DeployBot: scheduled rollout: API v2 staged rollout tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. plan: region-by-region (EU -> US -> APAC). canary 5% then step ramps. change-id: CR-2026-0421. assignees: @Maya R @Jason H. ops playbook: https://intra/redwood/releases/CR-2026-0421 :rocket:
Maya R: heads-up — we'll start EU. note: several mobile clients still report v1/missing header. can we get a quick list of top tenants that might break?
Jason H: on it. Kira, please run client header audit. example: `./tools/query_clients --since=30d --filter "api_version!=v2"`
Kira L: running now. quick summary: ~42 tenants with non-v2 traffic; top ones: acme-inc, beta-co, datazone (combined ~18% of EU traffic). I can deploy a short-lived routing shim to treat missing header as v1: `route_header_fallback: {"X-API-VERSION": "v1"}` if we need it.
Lucas T: infra status: v2 pools warmed (eu-west/us-east). saw a modest kv-cache memory uptick during last internal test — recommend `kv_throttle=true` during initial ramp. I'll flip before canary.
Ella (PM): release notes draft: "v2 tightens system message schema; older SDKs may not handle new fields." Will coordinate targeted comms to enterprise contacts 48h pre-relaunch.
Maya R: rollback criteria proposal: sustained control-plane 5xx >0.3% for 5m OR error-rate increase >1% vs baseline for 10m OR mobile crash reports spike >0.2% absolute. Agree?
Jason H: agree. who can trigger rollback? ops + release leads?
Nate - oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. I can run `deploybot rollback CR-2026-0421` if needed.
DeployBot: canary started 02:10 UTC -> routing=5% (eu-west). telemetry: /ops/telemetry/CR-2026-0421. Dashboards live. :eyes:
DeployBot: ALERT: canary telemetry -> 5xx rose to 0.6% over last 4m (threshold 0.3%). alert=A-CR-2026-01
Maya R: pause the ramp and hold traffic at 5%. @Jason H can you freeze routing?
Jason H: freezing ramp. `routingctl set-split CR-2026-0421 5%` -> done.
Kira L: logs show client-side parse errors from SDK 1.0 when encountering the new `system_messages` field. sample stack: `TypeError: cannot read property 'system' of undefined at parseSystemMessage (sdk.js:412)`. Affected tenants match the earlier list.
Lucas T: infra metrics (CPU, mem, latency) look normal; autoscale stable. this smells like client parsing regressions rather than infra failures.
Maya R: based on the crash signal + 5xx spike, let's rollback. Jason, please initiate rollback and mark the change rolled-back.
Jason H: `deploybot rollback CR-2026-0421 --reason "client parsing crash + 5xx"` -> initiating now.
DeployBot: rollback started by Jason H at 02:20 UTC. rolling routing back to v1 defaults.
DeployBot: rollback complete 02:24 UTC. routing restored to 100% v1. CR-2026-0421 status=rolled-back. incident: https://intra/redwood/incidents/CR-2026-0421-followup
Maya R: next steps: 1) Kira to prioritize SDK 1.0 compat patch for `system_messages` parsing, 2) Ella to send targeted 48h notice to top affected tenants, 3) Jason to draft a guarded re-run plan (smaller canary, client soft-pin window).
Kira L: opening PR for hotfix now, targeting patch release.
Ella (PM): I'll draft comms in 30m and tag enterprise success.
Jason H: prepping guarded relaunch plan: will include 1% canary, extended soft-pin for 12-24h, and gating telemetry hooks.
Nate - oncall: I'll watch crash telemetry for 24h. ping me if we schedule the relaunch window.
Maya R: closing this thread; follow-up postmortem WIP: https://intra/redwood/releases/CR-2026-0421-postmortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
